# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the overall RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Runs one complete TDD cycle with GREEN retries and learning loop |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python TDD cycles |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase via LLM |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment to write |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer for containerised test runs |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | ContainerRunner implementation using rootless Podman |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Manages playbook creation, updates, merging, and retrieval |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Unified logger for TDD and ML experiments with PostgreSQL/SQLite fallback |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes reflector insights into actionable playbook updates |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers (OpenRouter, Ollama, etc.) |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Checks generated code for forbidden imports and builtins |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval system for selecting relevant playbook bullets |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval service for all code generation activities |
| ContextGraphRetriever | src/retrieval/cgr3_retriever.py | CGR³: Context Graph Retrieve-Rank-Reason retriever |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates performance metrics from audit trail |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| CapabilityRegistry | src/broker/capability_registry.py | Anonymous agent capability tracking |
| BrokerAdvisor | src/broker/advisor.py | Recommends agents by capability fit |
| HumanDecisionInterface | src/broker/human_decision.py | Interface for human decision-making in agent selection |
| FeedbackCollector | src/broker/feedback.py | Stores human ratings and derives blended/drift scores |
| RegressionDetector | src/broker/regression_detector.py | Tracks quality changes across model versions and detects regressions |
| ModelAttributionTracker | src/benchmark/model_attribution.py | Tracks OpenRouter model attribution in performance metrics |
| ProductionDataAnalyzer | src/benchmark/production_analyzer.py | Analyzes quality data from experiment_logs |
| BlindEvaluator | src/benchmark/blind_evaluation.py | Scores outputs without knowing which agent produced them |
| SuccessRateCalculator | src/analytics/success_rate_calculator.py | Measures experiment success rates across the system |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | src/analytics/token_efficiency.py | Computes token efficiency scores from LanguagePod run data |
| CostQualityAnalyzer | src/analytics/cost_quality_analyzer.py | Analyzes cost-quality tradeoffs for model performance data |
| PlaybookReliabilityAnalyzer | src/reliability/playbook_analyzer.py | Correlates bullet retrieval with first-pass GREEN success |
| TDDCycleAnalyzer | src/reliability/tdd_cycle_analyzer.py | Measures first-pass GREEN rate and trend over time |
| AutonomousTDDAgent | src/agents/autonomous_tdd_agent.py | Higher-level autonomous TDD agent that builds features incrementally |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec |
| EnsembleLearner | src/ensemble/learner.py | Orchestrates multiple models learning in parallel with voting |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orch as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Reflect as Reflector
    participant Curate as Curator
    participant PB as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger

    User->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    activate Runner
    loop max_iterations
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        activate Planner
        Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement
        deactivate Planner

        Runner->>Cycle: run(PodSpec)
        activate Cycle

        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        activate Worker
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file: code})
        activate Orch
        Orch->>Container: send_pulse(files)
        activate Container
        Container-->>Orch: PulseResult
        deactivate Container
        Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orch
        Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult (RED)
        deactivate Pod

        alt RED failed (expected)
            Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
            activate Pod
            loop max_green_attempts
                Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error)
                activate Worker
                Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
                deactivate Worker
                Pod->>Orch: pulse({test, impl})
                activate Orch
                Orch->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                activate Container
                Container-->>Orch: PulseResult
                deactivate Container
                Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Orch
                alt GREEN passed
                    break
                end
            end
            Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult (GREEN)
            deactivate Pod

            alt GREEN passed
                Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Orch: pulse({test, impl})
                activate Orch
                Orch->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                activate Container
                Container-->>Orch: PulseResult
                deactivate Container
                Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Orch
                Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult (REFACTOR)
                deactivate Pod

                Cycle->>Reflect: reflect(task, gen, env)
                activate Reflect
                Reflect-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                deactivate Reflect

                Cycle->>Curate: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                activate Curate
                Curate-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
                deactivate Curate

                Cycle->>PB: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                activate PB
                PB-->>Cycle: added_bullets
                deactivate PB

                Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
                activate Logger
                Logger-->>Cycle: ExperimentLogModel
                deactivate Logger

            else GREEN failed
                Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(failure)
                activate Logger
                Logger-->>Cycle: ExperimentLogModel
                deactivate Logger
            end

        else RED passed (unexpected)
            Note right of Cycle: Abort cycle - test should fail
        end

        deactivate Cycle
    end
    Runner-->>User: IterativeResult
    deactivate Runner
```
